item.title: Strategic adaptation of MNEs in a fragmented global institutional landscape
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how multinational enterprises navigate and adapt their strategies in response to an increasingly fragmented and complex global institutional environment. The focus is on understanding the mechanisms and approaches MNEs employ to manage institutional diversity across different markets and regions.
